Meeting Date:                 7/20/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Misc. Transmittal
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 11-H at 4160 N Lincoln Ave
                              -App No. 21097
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                            Ordinance


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is

hereby amended by changing all the Bl-2 Neighborhood Shopping Zoning District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 11-H in the area bounded by



A line 45 feet southeasterly of West Berteau Avenue as measured along the southwest line of North
Lincoln Avenue and perpendicular thereto; North Lincoln Avenue; a line 70 feet southeasterly of
West Berteau Avenue as measured along the southwest line of North Lincoln Avenue and
perpendicular thereto; and the alley next southwest of North Lincoln Avenue.


to those of a Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial Zoning District.



SECTION 2. This ordinance be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property:          4160 North Lincoln Avenue
                                         CITY OF CHICAGO

                          APPLICATION FOR AN AMENDMENT TO
                           THE CHICAGO ZONING ORDINANCE

       No.



9.    Present Zoning District Bl-2                       Proposed Zoning District Cl-2

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions) 125' x 25'

11.   Current Use of the property Commercial (Prior commercial tenant operated a barbecue restaurant).

12.   Reason for rezoning the property To allow for general restaurant use in the commercial space.




13.   Describe the proposed use of the property ailter the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
      units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and
      height ofthe proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)
       The proposed use ofthe 1st floor commercial space (approximately 1,600 square feet-interior &

       exterior) is a general restaurant serving food/alcoholic beverages. There are no dwelling units. There

       is a two-car parking garage in the rear ofthe lot. The height ofthe building is approximately 14 feet.

14.   The Affordable Requrements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units and/or
      a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive a zoning
      change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing Planned
      Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
      www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?


      YES                               NOX
